Dashboard.title: Good evening
Dashboard.intro: Cued is connected to your media server and ready to learn what you enjoy.
Dashboard.statusBody: The application shell, API and database are in place.
Dashboard.emptyBody: Recommendations and media activity will appear here once their milestones are complete.
Dashboard.error: The application service could not be reached.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.intro: Manage your account, appearance, language and server integrations.
Settings.integrationsHelp: Configure Jellyfin and TMDB, inspect their health and manage imported libraries.
Settings.usersHelp: Inspect Jellyfin users, roles and library permissions.
Settings.appearanceHelp: Choose the theme used on this device.
Settings.languageHelp: Choose the language used by Cued.
Settings.tmdbAttribution: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

Setup.title: Connect Jellyfin
Setup.intro: Connect Cued to the Jellyfin server that will provide users, libraries and watch history.
Setup.apiKeyHelp: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
Setup.encryptionHelp: Add CUED_ENCRYPTION_KEY before storing an API key. You can add the key later as an administrator.

errors.unreachable: Cued could not connect to that Jellyfin server.
errors.encryption: Secret encryption must be configured before saving an API key.

Login.title: Sign in with Jellyfin
Login.intro: Use your {server} account. Your password is sent only to Jellyfin and is never stored by Cued.

errors.credentials: The username or password was not accepted by Jellyfin.
errors.unavailable: Sign-in is unavailable. Check the Jellyfin connection and secret encryption configuration.

Integrations.title: Integrations
Integrations.intro: Manage the services that provide Cued with users, media and activity.
Integrations.jellyfinHelp: Jellyfin is the source of truth for users, libraries and watch state in this milestone.
Integrations.jellyfinConfigurationHelp: Configure the Jellyfin server and the API key used for library synchronization.
Integrations.apiKeyHelp: Leave blank to keep the stored key.
Integrations.encryptionHelp: Add CUED_ENCRYPTION_KEY before storing an API key.
Integrations.notConnectedHelp: Save a valid server URL to connect.
Integrations.librariesHelp: Cued imports only selected libraries. Each user's Jellyfin permissions are applied separately.

libraryErrors.failed: Library selection could not be saved.

Integrations.synchronizationHelp: Sync recent updates quickly, or run a full reconciliation against Jellyfin.

syncResults.updates: Updated {items} media items across {libraries} libraries and {users} users.
syncResults.full: Fully synchronized {libraries} libraries, {items} media items and {users} users.

syncErrors.failed: Synchronization failed. Check the integration status and try again.

errors.invalid: Check the server URL and try again.
errors.unreachable: Cued could not connect to Jellyfin.
errors.encryption: Secret encryption must be configured before saving an API key.

TmdbIntegration.title: TMDB
TmdbIntegration.help: TMDB provides localized discovery metadata, imagery, people, credits and trailers.
TmdbIntegration.configurationHelp: Configure the API Read Access Token used for search and discovery metadata.
TmdbIntegration.accessTokenHelp: Leave blank to keep the encrypted token already stored.
TmdbIntegration.encryptionHelp: Add CUED_ENCRYPTION_KEY before storing a TMDB token.
TmdbIntegration.tokenStored: An access token is already stored
TmdbIntegration.connectedHelp: Search and localized metadata are available.
TmdbIntegration.notConnectedHelp: Add a TMDB API Read Access Token to enable discovery.

errors.invalid: Enter a valid TMDB API Read Access Token.
errors.unreachable: Cued could not connect to TMDB.
errors.encryption: Secret encryption must be configured before saving the token.

Search.unavailableBody: Ask an administrator to configure or check the TMDB integration.
